descriptions.preferred: The brilliant coral color of the bark is the outstanding feature of this maple and gives it its name which means "coral tower." At times the color becomes almost fluorescent. The younger the wood, the stronger the color. It has long been a popular cultivar in the nursery trade, and wide. The margins are double serrated. On the strongest-growing new shoots, the leaves are at least 1 cm larger in each dimension. Leaf color is a bright tone of green. The edges of the new leaves have a strong reddish tinge which fades as the Archives, Corvallis ferred to this cultivar as dull during the fall season, but in the Pacific Northwest and in Europe it is quite showy almost every fall. This upright-growing tree gradually spreads at the top as it ages. It tends to become quite twiggy inside, but 'Sango kaku'. The winter bark coloration is an attractive feature of this cultivar. Archives, Corvallis Young plants grow quite fast for the first few years and then take on a multibranching and thickening habit of growth. Planted near the contrasting green-barked cultivar

sources.title: 珊瑚阁 Acer Palmatum 'Sango Kaku'
sources.description: 树皮绚丽的珊瑚色是珊瑚阁的显著特征，它也因此得名。典型的 掌状 叶有 5到7裂，春天浅黄色的叶子带有红色的叶边缘，随着夏季临近，树叶变成明亮的绿色。 秋天， 叶子 颜色变成黄金色，混合着杏色和浅红色。 落叶后会露出树干， 枝上明亮的珊瑚红色树皮，为冬季景观增添一抹 亮丽的 色彩。 该品种曾经以 "Senkaki"这个名字而闻名，现在它已成为同义词 。 "Ebi-no-hige"是该品种的日语同义词。它也 曾 被称为 " Cinnabarinum " , " Cinnabar Wood Maple "和" Coral Bark Maple "。珊瑚阁 荣获英国皇家园艺学会(RHS) 花园优异奖 。成年树高可达 8米，非常适合当作庭院景观，与绿色和橙色树皮的枫树搭配种植。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 本品种最突出的特征是树皮鲜艳的珊瑚色，这也是其名称“coral tower（珊瑚塔）”的由来；有时其色泽甚至近乎荧光。枝条越幼嫩，色彩越强烈。它长期以来一直是苗圃业中很受欢迎的品种。叶缘为重锯齿。在生长最旺的新梢上，叶片各方向通常都至少大 1 厘米。叶色为明亮的绿色，新叶边缘带有明显的红色晕染，随后逐渐褪去。文中夹杂的档案/OCR 内容显示其秋色曾被描述为较暗淡，但在太平洋西北地区和欧洲，它几乎每年秋季都颇具观赏性。该树初期直立生长，随着树龄增加，顶部逐渐开展。树冠内部常会变得枝条细密。'Sango kaku' 的冬季枝皮着色尤具观赏价值。幼株在最初几年生长较快，随后形成多分枝并逐渐增粗的生长习性。若与绿皮品种

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 造景观赏、城市庭院、露台/容器栽培、岩石园、乡村/自然式花园、低维护

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 大型落叶灌木或小乔木，高可达 6 米；嫩枝呈珊瑚红色，着生 5 裂叶，展叶时为粉黄绿色，夏季转绿，秋季变黄。花小，带红色。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Sango kaku' Coral Bark Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Sango kaku' Coral Bark Sango kaku Japanese Maple Zones 6-9 ‘Sango kaku’ is a beautiful large coral bark Japanese maple. This Japanese maple tree has a spectacular bright red bark that stands out in any time of the year! The leaf of 'Sango kaku' in the early spring is a vibrant lush green and new growth often has light flushing of red on the edging. The fall color of ‘Sango kaku’ is a beautiful bright gold-yellow with hints of red splashed in. The golden-yellow contrast magnificently with the coral bark. ‘Sango kaku’ grows best in sun to filtered light. Heavy shade tends to wash out the bark color on some coral barks. ‘Sango kaku’ can reach up to 20-25 ft over time. It may surprise you to find out that we enjoy ‘Sango kaku’ the most after the leaves had dropped. The cool temperatures brighten the coral bark Japanese maple as it adds amazing color even late in winter after all the other garden colors are gone. The bright warm colors of the red bark stand out so nicely accompanied by snowfall and this is one of our personal favorite times to view the beauty of ‘Sango kaku’. This amazing coral bark Japanese maple tree is sure to add year-round color to your garden and become one of favorites to photograph in any season.
